structure_assets.description: Main Figure 1A absorption/PL and 1B TEM of 2.9 nm baseline QDs; source pixels, not a model.
SI Figure S1 histogram of 75 diameters from main Figure 1B; mean 2.9 nm and SD 0.3 nm.
Author-drawn schematic of roughly spherical QDs, based on main Figure 1B; not measured coordinates.

Main Figure 2 ligand-dependent optical response; (Me)2N-An is from a separate 3.0 nm batch, so the entire plot is not one structure specimen. Steady-state PL/PL0 measured with 503 nm excitation, distinct from the 540 nm band-edge absorption maximum.
Main Figure 6A measured PL/PL0 for the separate 3.2 nm group 1/2 split batch; panel B is a conceptual surface-coverage schematic, not measured particle structure.
SI Figure S10 1H/31P NMR free-ligand comparison of the group 1/2 QD dispersions; not a crystal or morphology label.

quality.review_scope: Selected synthesis, ligand-treatment, purification and linked outcomes accepted after full independent scoped source review and corrective verification. conflicts: Main printed 1044 explicitly assigns the Figure 2 (Me)2N-An steady-state series to a separate 3.0 nm batch. SI Figure S2 labels its time-dependent kinetics experiment 2.9 nm for each R-An. Whether these are the same batch or distinct experiments is unresolved; no contradiction or 2.9 nm TEM link is imposed.
Figure 6 group 1/2 QDs are 3.2 nm; the 20.3 ± 4.8% and 11.8 ± 3.7% PL quantum yields are means over ten 2.7–3.2 nm batches, not exact Figure 6-pair values.
